title: Lab 4B — Fargate right-sizing
topic: Fargate CPU/memory sizing, vCPU-GB-second billing, Fargate Spot vs On-Demand, Compute Savings Plans vs RIs, Compute Optimizer, CloudWatch utilization, ECS RunTask monthly batch cost, ephemeral storage, capacity providers
format: 15 timed scenario questions (~24 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces night-31-fargate-rightsizing-cost.md and gsa-fargate-rightsizing-map.md. Answer without peeking at night-31-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×4 B×4 C×4 D×3 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: Global Ski Atlas runs the Iceland pipeline monthly via EventBridge → ecs:RunTask on Fargate (2 vCPU, 4 GiB) for about two hours. CloudWatch shows CPUUtilization p95 at 22% and MemoryUtilization p95 at 35% across three runs. What is the best next cost step before changing purchase models?

options.A: Register a new task definition with lower CPU and memory matched to measured use
options.B: Replace the Fargate batch transform with Aurora Serverless v2 for the same job
options.C: Purchase EC2 Reserved Instances expecting them to discount Fargate RunTask spend
options.D: Enable S3 Transfer Acceleration on the pipeline output bucket to cut compute cost

questions.question: The Iceland batch job can retry next month if interrupted and tolerates a two-minute warning. Which Fargate purchase option best reduces per-run cost?

options.A: Fargate On-Demand — simplest path and always cheapest for monthly batch work
options.B: Fargate Spot capacity provider on the RunTask / capacity strategy
options.C: EC2 Dedicated Hosts to isolate the batch for compliance and license control
options.D: Lambda Provisioned Concurrency sized to cover the entire OSM download window

questions.question: Finance sees steady Fargate, Lambda, and EC2 spend across multiple teams and wants a flexible 1-year commit that applies across instance families and Regions. Which option fits?

options.A: S3 Intelligent-Tiering monitoring fee waiver for all pipeline prefixes
options.B: EC2 Instance Savings Plan locked to m6i.large in us-east-1a only
options.C: Compute Savings Plan covering Fargate, Lambda, and EC2 spend flexibly
options.D: RDS Reserved Instance attached to the ECS cluster for Fargate discount

questions.question: How does AWS bill a Fargate task while it is in RUNNING state in us-east-1 Linux x86?

options.A: Per ECS cluster hour regardless of how many tasks are running
options.B: Per NAT Gateway hour for each ENI the task attaches in the VPC
options.C: Per EventBridge rule invocation that started the task, with no compute meter
options.D: Per vCPU-second and per GiB-second of the configured task CPU and memory

questions.question: A developer registers an ECS Fargate task definition with 2048 CPU units (2 vCPU) and 512 MiB memory. Registration fails. What is the most likely cause?

options.A: 512 MiB is below the minimum memory allowed for 2 vCPU on Fargate
options.B: Fargate requires awsvpc mode with assignPublicIp ENABLED for registration
options.C: The task role ARN must exactly match the execution role name string
options.D: EventBridge cannot target any task definition configured above 1 vCPU

questions.question: After right-sizing Iceland from 2 vCPU / 4 GiB to 1 vCPU / 2 GiB, a task stops with exit code 137 and stoppedReason mentioning OutOfMemoryError. What should you do?

options.A: Switch container logs to S3 Glacier Deep Archive hoping to free task RAM
options.B: Increase memory in the task definition — RAM was undersized for the job
options.C: Disable the execution role so the task cannot pull container images from ECR
options.D: Move the task to a public subnet and enable assignPublicIp for more memory

questions.question: night-31-lab compares ecs-task-pipeline-sizing.json scenarios. The pmtiles-heavy row uses 4 vCPU / 8 GiB for embarrassingly parallel tile builds. Which compute pattern from Night 27 is usually cheaper at planet scale?

options.A: A single Fargate On-Demand task left running continuously for tile builds
options.B: Aurora Multi-AZ writer used as the primary tile rendering engine
options.C: AWS Batch on Spot compute with parallel jobs writing finished tiles to S3
options.D: ElastiCache Redis configured as the durable long-term tile storage layer

questions.question: Compute Optimizer returns no ECS recommendations for globalskiatlas-backend-k8s-iceland even though tasks ran last month. What is the most plausible explanation?

options.A: Fargate tasks cannot be analyzed until every workload is converted to Lambda
options.B: Compute Optimizer only supports EC2 Classic networking for ECS recommendations
options.C: S3 lifecycle rules on the output bucket block Compute Optimizer enrollment paths
options.D: RunTask-only workloads may lack enrolled ECS service history for recommendations

questions.question: Night 12 schedules Iceland with cron(0 6 1 * ? *) instead of rate(1 minute). Which cost statement is correct?

options.A: Fargate compute dominates — monthly cron runs the expensive task about once per month
options.B: EventBridge per-invocation fees dominate — cron schedules are always more expensive
options.C: Fargate compute is free whenever the task is started by an EventBridge schedule rule
options.D: NAT Gateway hourly charges stop automatically when EventBridge schedules start tasks

questions.question: Durable GeoParquet output from Iceland must survive task stop. Where should final artifacts live to optimize cost and durability?

options.A: Fargate ephemeral storage only — avoids S3 PUT charges for pipeline output
options.B: S3 Standard (with Night 30 lifecycle aging older iceland/ prefixes)
options.C: EC2 Instance Store on a Spot worker as the only durable copy of output
options.D: CloudWatch Logs streams as the long-term system of record for GeoParquet

questions.question: Your account runs Fargate tasks in private subnets. The monthly bill shows NAT Gateway data processing far exceeds Fargate vCPU charges. What network change best attacks that line item?

options.A: Shrink task CPU from 2 vCPU to 0.25 vCPU hoping to cut NAT data processing
options.B: Place an internet-facing ALB in front of the monthly batch Fargate RunTask
options.C: Add S3 gateway and ECR interface endpoints so pull/PUT traffic avoids NAT
options.D: Enable S3 Object Lock on the output bucket to eliminate NAT Gateway charges

questions.question: Which statement best contrasts Compute Savings Plans with EC2 Reserved Instances for a team using mostly Fargate RunTask?

options.A: Reserved Instances automatically discount Fargate vCPU-seconds with no setup needed
options.B: Savings Plans require identical instance type and AZ for every compute workload run
options.C: Neither purchase model reduces Fargate — only S3 lifecycle rules lower compute cost
options.D: Savings Plans commit flexible compute spend; standard RIs lock specific EC2 attributes

questions.question: A task definition sets ephemeralStorage sizeInGiB to 100 for large local scratch during OSM extract. How is extra ephemeral storage beyond the default billed on Fargate?

options.A: Billed per additional GiB-hour of configured ephemeral storage beyond default
options.B: Included free up to 1 TiB for every Fargate task definition revision registered
options.C: Billed only when scratch objects are later transitioned into Glacier storage classes
options.D: Charged as EBS io2 provisioned IOPS independent of the configured task CPU setting

questions.question: An ops lead wants CloudWatch to justify downsizing Iceland. Which metrics pair best supports a rightsizing decision?

options.A: S3 NumberOfObjects and BucketSizeBytes on the pipeline output bucket
options.B: ECS CPUUtilization and MemoryUtilization percentiles across multiple task runs
options.C: Route 53 HealthCheckStatus combined with DNS query count for the apex domain
options.D: AWS Budgets forecasted spend alone — runtime utilization metrics are unnecessary

questions.question: Night 10 proved Iceland in private subnets with assignPublicIp DISABLED. A teammate suggests enabling a public IP to reduce Fargate cost. What is correct?

options.A: Public IP removes Fargate vCPU charges for the full duration of each task run
options.B: Public IP halves the memory the task definition must request for the same workload
options.C: Public IP does not change Fargate CPU/memory billing and weakens private-tier design
options.D: Public IP is required before any Fargate Spot capacity provider strategy can be used
